name: human curiosity
description: What curiosity is, how it is defined and measured, and what distinguishes genuine learning-driven curiosity from mere novelty-seeking or randomness.

name: agentic behavior
description: How autonomous AI agents form goals, make decisions, and act independently rather than simply responding to direct instructions.

name: goal prioritization
description: How an agent decides which of several competing goals or tasks to pursue at a given moment, and how that priority changes over time.

name: memory as a predictor
description: How a memory of past experience can be used to predict future outcomes, and how measuring prediction error reveals what has and has not really been learned.

name: free will
description: Whether a choice made by a deterministic system can be meaningfully described as free, and what the felt experience of choosing has to do with the underlying mechanism that produced it.
